title: Tangent points have density θ (Def. 1.1 ⇒ Θ^n(μ_V, x) = θ)
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N, x ∈ ℝ^N, T ∈ G(N,n), θ ∈ ℝ with HasTangentPlane V x T θ. Then the n-dimensional density of μ_V at x exists and equals θ: μ_V(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρ^n) → θ as ρ ↓ 0, i.e. HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ) (closed balls B_ρ(x), ω_n = unitBallVolume n).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ)
